incidents-bot: Alert — high KV cache memory growth detected in us-west-2 serving group 'gpt-3.5-awq' and 'gptq-800m'. Paging thresholds exceeded on node set prod-gpu-3. Automatic mitigation didn't keep up. Triggering on-call.
Maya R: I'm on it. Symptoms? Is this causing 503s or only paging/latency? @Ashwin P can you paste recent logs?
Ashwin P: seeing rapid KV allocations + kernel fallbacks. Affected pools: awq-int8 primary path and gptq fallback. Customer-facing errors: increased tail latency, a handful of 5xx spikes when paging kicked in.
Ashwin P: logs:
```
2026-05-12T14:02:13Z runtime: kv_cache_alloc size=1.2GB model=gpt-3.5-awq shard=2
2026-05-12T14:02:13Z kernel-selector: chosen=awq-int8 kernel=awq_int8_fast (fallback_count=0)
2026-05-12T14:02:14Z kernel-selector: fallback -> fp16_matmul reason=kernel_failed_alloc
2026-05-12T14:02:14Z kv-cache: increase footprint after dequantize -> +900MB (per-request)
2026-05-12T14:02:15Z paging: write_queue len=23 eviction_rate=0.33
2026-05-12T14:02:16Z request: id=... status=500 reason=paging-exhausted
```
Emily S: FYI this started after the kernel-routing tweak from last night that prefers awq-int8 for the AWQ model family. The selector change added an awq path optimization (PR #4892). Suspect path chooses awq-int8 but then dequantizes/expands KV into fp16 on some layers -> larger in-memory KV.
Maya R: OK immediate mitigation options: 1) toggle kernel routing to prefer stable fp16 path for this model family; 2) reduce continuous batching window + lower max tokens per batch; 3) enable KV compression (force compress_kv=true) if supported; 4) increase paging headroom temporarily. Prefer minimal blast radius: flip kernel routing first + reduce batching.
Kevin L: I can flip the kernel flag and lower batching. Rolling a non-disruptive config via Console API. Patch will target model-group: prod/gpt-3.5-awq and prod/gptq-800m. Will keep autoscaling and evictions as-is.
deploy-bot: Runbook link: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/kv-cache-paging

Commands to run (Console API):
```
# prefer fp16 kernel path for awq group
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/model-groups/prod-gpt-3-5-awq/config \
  -d '{"kernel_routing":{"priority":["fp16","awq-int8","gptq"]}}'

# reduce continuous batching window
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/serving-configs/continuous-batching \
  -d '{"window_ms":2, "max_tokens_per_batch":256}'
```
deploy-bot: patch submitted: change-id=chg_20260512_001, rolling to pool prod-gpu-3. Estimated 30s to config propagation.
deploy-bot: config applied successfully on 5/12 14:03:02 UTC — change-id=chg_20260512_001
incidents-bot: Automated metric check: paging write_queue length down from 23 -> 3 over 120s. Eviction_rate reduced. Latency p95 improved from 1.2s -> 380ms for the affected model family.
Ashwin P: confirming memory footprint stabilized. KV growth stopped at ~1.3GB cap after the kernel route change. Throughput dropped ~8% due to fp16 path being slower for some ops but ok for now.
cs-Anna: Customer impact summary (tickets):
- TCK-1142 (Acme) saw 503s during 14:02–14:06, SLA hit. Notifying them and offering postmortem.
- TCK-1145 (Maply) saw transient latency spikes, no rollout required.
Support-bot: Auto-created incident record INC-2026-1372 and linked tickets [TCK-1142, TCK-1145].
Maya R: Handoff to Kevin L for night coverage. Current status: mitigation applied (kernel routing pref->fp16 + batching window lowered). Paging stabilised. Impacted model groups are under watch. Remaining work: follow-up regression test for kernel-selector, add kv footprint test to nightly CI, and root-cause postmortem.
Kevin L: Taking over. Action items assigned:
- Track paging metrics for next 4h and escalate if paging restarts. (dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/kv-paging)
- Create GH issue for selector regression and link PR #4892. (https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/issues/721)
- Coordinate with runtime-team to benchmark awq-int8 dequantization memory profile.
I will also schedule a canary where awq-int8 is re-enabled with a memory guard.
Maya R: Thanks, Kevin. CS notified customers and logged remediation commitments. I'll start the postmortem doc and ping runtime for RCA.
Kevin L: Noted. I'll update this thread with 1h and 4h checks. If anything new pops up, @Maya R please re-alert.
Maya R: Closing immediate incident handoff. Follow-ups: postmortem, CI test, selector fix. Good job team :thumbsup:
